opis: The bright children's room from the reference picture (the same blue-striped wallpaper, big window, bed and bookcase), a birthday party: colourful paper garlands across the wall and three balloons. In the middle the small HEDGEHOG, very happy, holds up a PICTURE in a wide colourful FRAME (stripes of red, yellow, green and blue): the picture in it shows a little cream cottage with a red triangular roof, blue sky, a yellow sun and a small hedgehog by the door. On one side the OWL spreads its wings proudly, on the other the SQUIRREL claps her paws. A round pink birthday cake on a small table. Warm, joyful and sunny.
